arxiv-2107-07909.title: Discovery and implications of hidden atomic-scale structure in a metallic meteorite
arxiv-2107-07909.creator: András Kovács, Laura H. Lewis, Dhanalaksmi Palanisamy, Thibaud Denneulin, Alexander Schwedt, Edward R.D. Scott, Baptiste Gault, Dierk Raabe, Rafal E. Dunin-Borkowski, Michalis Charilaou
arxiv-2107-07909.description: Abstract Iron and its alloys have made modern civilization possible, with metallic meteorites providing one of the human’s earliest sources of usable iron as well as providing a window into our solar system’s billion-year history. Here highest-resolution tools reveal the existence of a previously hidden FeNi nanophase within the extremely slowly cooled metallic meteorite NWA 6259.

arxiv-2108-01650.title: Application of Hardy inequalities for some singular parabolic equations
arxiv-2108-01650.creator: Nikolai Kutev, Tsviatko Rangelov
arxiv-2108-01650.description: Abstract Boundary value problems for non-linear parabolic equations with singular potentials are considered. Existence and non-existence results as an application of different Hardy inequalities are proved. Blow-up conditions are investigated too. † † Corresponding author: T. Rangelov, rangelov@math.bas.bg Key words. Singular parabolic equations, Hardy inequalities. Math. Subj. Class.

arxiv-2207-02417.title: A comparative study of different machine learning methods for dissipative quantum dynamics
arxiv-2207-02417.creator: Luis E. Herrera Rodríguez, Arif Ullah, Kennet J. Rueda Espinosa, Pavlo O. Dral, Alexei A. Kananenka
arxiv-2207-02417.description: Abstract It has been recently shown that supervised machine learning (ML) algorithms can accurately and efficiently predict the long-time populations dynamics of dissipative quantum systems given only short-time population dynamics. In the present article we benchmaked 22 ML models on their ability to predict long-time dynamics of a two-level quantum system linearly coupled to harmonic bath.

arxiv-2209-02402.title: Topic Detection in Continuous Sign Language Videos
arxiv-2209-02402.creator: Álvaro Budria 1, Laia Tarrés 1, Gerard I. Gállego 1, Jordi Torres 1, 3], Xavier Giró-i-Nieto 1, 2]
arxiv-2209-02402.description: Abstract Significant progress has been made recently on challenging tasks in automatic sign language understanding, such as sign language recognition, translation and production. However, these works have focused on datasets with relatively few samples, short recordings and limited vocabulary and signing space. In this work, we introduce the novel task of sign language topic detection.

arxiv-2209-10759.title: Microscopic description of the torque acting on fission fragments
arxiv-2209-10759.creator: Guillaume Scamps 1
arxiv-2209-10759.description: Abstract When two fragments are created in a fission decay, any torque due to nuclear and Coulomb interaction can change the fragment’s angular momentum. This article explores the character and magnitude of the angular momentum as a function of the initial conditions around the scission point using the time-dependent Hartree-Fock theory.

arxiv-2305-06375.title: A Leptonic Model for Neutrino Emission From Active Galactic Nuclei
arxiv-2305-06375.creator: Dan Hooper 1,2,3, Kathryn Plant 4
arxiv-2305-06375.description: Abstract It is often stated that the observation of high-energy neutrinos from an astrophysical source would constitute a smoking gun for the acceleration of hadronic cosmic rays. Here, we point out that there exists a purely leptonic mechanism to produce TeV-scale neutrinos in astrophysical environments.

arxiv-2308-13804.title: Multivariate Majorization in Principal–Agents Models
arxiv-2308-13804.creator: Nicholas C. Bedard, Jacob K. Goeree, Ningyi Sun
arxiv-2308-13804.description: Abstract We introduce a definition of multivariate majorization that is new to the economics literature. Our majorization technique allows us to generalize Mussa and Rosen’s (1978) “ironing” to a broad class of multivariate principal-agents problems. Specifically, we consider adverse selection problems in which agents’ types are one dimensional but informational externalities create a multidimensional ironing problem.

arxiv-2401-10326.title: The Smallness of Matter Effects in Long-Baseline Muon Neutrino Disappearance
arxiv-2401-10326.creator: Peter B. Denton, Stephen J. Parke
arxiv-2401-10326.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Peter B. Denton, Stephen J. Parke. Current long-baseline accelerator experiments, NOvA and T2K, are making excellent measurements of neutrino oscillations and the next generation of experiments, DUNE and HK, will make measurements at the 𝒪 ⁡ ( 1 % ) \mathcal{O}(1\%) level of precision.

arxiv-2405-00059.title: Microwave Cavity Mode Optimisation by Background Anti-Resonance Tuning
arxiv-2405-00059.creator: Michael T. Hatzon, Eugene N. Ivanov, Jeremy F. Bourhill, Maxim Goryachev, Michael E. Tobar
arxiv-2405-00059.description: Abstract To derive the best oscillator phase noise when implementing a high-Q resonator, the resonant spectral line-shape must have high contrast and symmetry. Ideally this line-shape is second-order and Lorentzian, however, in a high mode density spectral region, low-Q background spurious modes interact and distort the resonance.

arxiv-2408-04094.title: On endosplit p p -permutation resolutions and Broué’s conjecture for p p -solvable groups
arxiv-2408-04094.creator: Sam K. Miller
arxiv-2408-04094.description: Abstract . Endosplit p p -permutation resolutions play an instrumental role in verifying Broué’s abelian defect group conjecture in numerous cases. We give a new characterization of all endosplit p p -permutation resolutions and reduce the question of Galois descent of an endosplit p p -permutation resolution to the Galois descent of the module it resolves.

arxiv-2503-13658.title: Consistencies and inconsistencies in redshift-independent distances
arxiv-2503-13658.creator: José Antonio Nájera, Harry Desmond
arxiv-2503-13658.description: Abstract Redshift-independent distances underpin much of astrophysics, and there exists a plethora of methods to estimate them. However, the extent to which the distances they imply are consistent, while crucial for the integrity of the distance ladder, has been little explored.

pmc-11429142.title: Synthesis, Characterization and Assessment of Antioxidant and Melanogenic Inhibitory Properties of Edaravone Derivatives
pmc-11429142.creator: R Divya Mohan, S A Anaswara, Naveen V Kulkarni, Dimitar G Bojilov, Stanimir P Manolov, Iliyan I Ivanov, Jamelah S Al-Otaibi, Y Sheena Mary, Maria N Modica
pmc-11429142.description: A series of edaravone derivatives and the corresponding Cu(II) complexes were synthesized and characterized using spectroscopic and analytical techniques such as IR, UV, NMR and elemental analysis. Antioxidant activities of all compounds were examined using free radical scavenging methods such as hydrogen peroxide scavenging activity (HPSA), 1,1-diphenyl-2-picrylhydrazyl (DPPH) and 2-2′-azino-bis-(3-ethylbenzothiazoline-6-sulfonate) (ABTS) assays.

pmc-11653570.title: The spatiotemporal patterns of the beet webworm (Lepidoptera: Crambidae) in China and possible dynamics under future climate scenarios
pmc-11653570.creator: Jinping Zhang, Qin Yang, Zhengxue Zhao, Xiaofei Yu, Jianzhou Wei, Hua Cheng, Xuechun Zhao, Maofa Yang, Baocheng Jin, Rachid Hanna
pmc-11653570.description: The beet webworm (BWW), Loxostege sticticalis (L.), is a notorious migratory agriculture pest of crops and fodder plants, inducing sudden outbreaks and huge losses of food and forage production. Quantifying its spatiotemporal patterns and possible dynamics under future climate scenarios may have significant implications for management policies and practices against this destructive agriculture pest.

pmc-11679927.title: Risk Factors for Internal Jugular Vein Thrombosis 1 Month After Non-Cuffed Hemodialysis Catheter Removal
pmc-11679927.creator: Shun Yoshida, Yasuyo Sato, Tsukasa Naganuma, Ikuo Nukui, Masakiyo Wakasugi, Ayumu Nakashima, Maurizio Bossola
pmc-11679927.description: Background: Complications, namely, catheter-related thrombosis (CRT) and venous stenosis, are associated with non-cuffed hemodialysis catheters used for emergency vascular access. However, only a few reports have demonstrated changes in the venous lumen and intravenous thrombosis after catheter removal. In this study, we comprehensively investigated the risk factors for residual thrombus 1 month after hemodialysis catheter removal.

uslaw-usc-t25-s1682.title: 25 U.S.C. § 1682 — Subrogation of claims by Indian Health Service
uslaw-usc-t25-s1682.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s1682.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 18 (Indian Health Care); Subchapter VI (Miscellaneous). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. On and after October 18, 1986, the Indian Health Service may seek subrogation of claims including but not limited to auto accident claims, including no-fault claims, personal injury, disease, or disability claims, and worker’s compensation claims, the proceeds of which shall be credited.

uslaw-usc-t25-s415a.title: 25 U.S.C. § 415a — Lease of lands of deceased Indians for benefit of heirs or devisees
uslaw-usc-t25-s415a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s415a.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 12 (Lease, Sale, Or Surrender Of Allotted Or Unallotted Lands). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Restricted lands of deceased Indians may be leased under sections 415 to 415d of this title, for the benefit of their heirs or devisees, in the circumstances and by the persons prescribed in section 380 of this title: Provided, That.
